subject: RTBF / Data deletion follow-up & backup retention - next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintechco.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: RTBF / deletion requirements & next steps

Hi Olivia / Mateo -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned and can scope the action items:

Summary of your requirements:
- Users (end customers) must be able to submit a Right to be Forgotten (RTBF) request via API and UI.
- Deletion must remove PII and profile data from the primary serving DB within 72 hours of the request.
- Backups: you have a 30-day backup window but need guarantees about purge of user data beyond that window; want options for accelerated purge in high-priority cases.
- Audit/logging: you need deletion audit trail + confirmation events sent to your S3/secure webhook.
- Data residency: EU residency for EU users; US for US users.

Proposed next steps (what we'll do on our side):
1) Share our RTBF playbook and the deletion workflow that maps primary delete -> KV cache purge -> backup handling. (attached)
2) Confirm feasibility with infra/engineering on backup purge options and timelines - tagging Marcus and Dev.
3) Share sample audit event schema and delivery methods for your security team.
4) Draft mutual action plan and SLA for RTBF requests (including escalations).

Can you confirm: (a) 72 hours is your hard requirement for primary DB purge, and (b) for backups you need 30-day rolling retention but would like an option for expedited purge (we can propose options). Also let me know any specific compliance control docs your legal team needs.

I've attached our internal RTBF playbook and a proposed mapping template - happy to walk through this in a follow-up call.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-rtbf-playbook.pdf, fintechco-rtbf-mapping.xlsx

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintechco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@fintechco.com>, FintechCo DPO <legal@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: RTBF / deletion requirements & next steps

Thanks Camila - appreciate the clear recap. A couple clarifications from our side:

1) 72 hours for primary DB purge is a firm requirement for consumer-facing accounts. For enterprise customers under different contracts we may accept longer windows but let's assume 72 hours is the baseline.
2) Backups: we understand rolling 30-day backups, however the ask is that upon RTBF we need a documented process that either:
   - removes the user data from backups within a reasonable, documented timeline (we realize immediate deletion from immutable backups is often not possible), or
   - provides a technical and auditable mitigant (e.g., crypto-key destruction, logical redaction) and an estimated completion date.
3) Logs: we require deletion of any logs that contain PII identifiers tied to the user, and a way to query and receive confirmation we've asked for such deletions.
4) Residency: EU users must be processed/stored in EU regions only.

Can Marcus/Dev/Rishi confirm the backup options you mentioned and the logging audit support? Also copying our DPO (legal@fintechco.com) for any legal artifacts.

Olivia Grant
Head of Privacy & Compliance | FintechCo
olivia@fintechco.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintechco.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: RTBF / deletion requirements & next steps

Great - thanks for the clarifications, Olivia. Below I've summarized how Redwood can meet each item and where we need internal confirmation:

Primary DB purge (72h):
- We support immediate logical deletion of user records from the primary DB and will mark records as deleted and trigger downstream anonymization/cleanup jobs. Typical completion: within 24-72 hours depending on write-through queues for high-throughput tenants. We will provide a deletion confirmation event (webhook) when the primary deletion pipeline completes.

Backups / immutable snapshots:
- Our standard backup cadence is daily snapshots with a 30-day rolling retention. We cannot guarantee instant removal from historical snapshot binaries. Options we can offer:
  1) Expedited remediation path: for high-priority RTBFs we can run a targeted rehydrate-and-purge job for affected backup slices and then re-snapshot - estimated completion: 7-21 days depending on dataset size.
  2) Cryptographic key destruction: where supported, we can destroy the encryption keys to make the user data unrecoverable (suitable for some backup architectures).
  3) Logical redaction / indexing: redacting PII at index level for logs/backups; provides quicker mitigation but is workload-dependent.

We'll need to validate which option works with your backup storage provider and how that maps to your SLA expectations.

Logs / audit trail:
- We can provide a deletion request scanner to find PII identifiers in common application logs and route events to a secure purge queue. We can emit an audit event for each deletion step (primary purge, cache purge, backup remediations) and deliver a signed confirmation JSON to your webhook or S3 bucket.

Data residency:
- Redwood can scope tenant processing by region. EU user deletion requests can be routed to EU-only processing nodes and storage.

Open questions for our engineering/legal teams (cc: Marcus, Dev, Rishi):
- Can we commit to the expedited backup purge timeline (7-21 days) as a documented remediation option?
- For the cryptographic key destruction option, what are the implications on our backup restore SLAs?
- Are there any limitations for third-party managed backup providers that would prevent rehydration/purge?

I've attached our RTBF playbook and a sample audit-event schema. Marcus / Dev - can you confirm feasibility and provide a rough ETA by EOD tomorrow? Rishi - can you review the proposed mitigations for legal acceptability?

Thanks,

Camila
Attachments: redwood-rtbf-playbook.pdf, fintechco-rtbf-mapping.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FintechCo RTBF - backup purge feasibility

Hey team -

Following the discovery with FintechCo, they've confirmed 72h primary purge is a baseline and want documented options for backups (they expect 30-day retention but need remediation options for RTBF). Action items:

1) Marcus / Dev: please validate the expedited backup purge path (rehydrate -> purge -> re-snapshot) and whether 7-21 days is realistic for a typical FintechCo-sized tenant (estimate 5-10 TB). Include notes on any operational costs and whether we need support from storage provider.
2) Dev: confirm if cryptographic key destruction is available for our existing backup flow and what consequences that has for recoverability / restore tests.
3) Rishi: please review the language below for customer-facing docs and whether cryptographic key destruction is acceptable as a mitigation (we should note any limitations).
4) I'll draft a short mutual action plan and delivery timeline to share with Olivia by EOD Friday.

I've attached the mapping template they filled in (fintechco-rtbf-mapping.xlsx) and our RTBF playbook.

Thanks -
Camila
